fields.acceptance: go test -trimpath ./internal/web -run 'TestWebAnswerFormsCarryCSRFAndAreAbsentWithoutToken|TestWebAnswerPostConfirms|TestWebApproveRefusesMissingCSRF|TestWebAnswerMergedInboxFormsPostIntoTheProject' shows the answer and approve forms carry the CSRF field and are absent when no token is set, answers a question and approves a sign-off through POST with the token and the CSRF field, shows the confirmation, and refuses an answer or approve POST missing the CSRF field; go test -trimpath ./internal/api -run 'TestWebAnswerAction|TestWebApproveAction' shows a POST through WebProjectHandler, and through WebRootHandler's merged inbox at the root, runs the real question.answer and inbox.approve or run.approve on the project's log.
fields.statement: From the web UI the owner answers an open question (question.answer) and approves a sign-off (inbox.approve or run.approve), and the page then says what happened ('Answered. The run continues.').
